title: Zesty Silky Kenyan Cashew Curry
description: A tangy and indulgent Kenyan dish featuring cashews, this pescatarian-friendly curry is perfect for a special occasion, with a rich and silky texture from the coconut milk and cashew cream.
instructions: Drain and rinse the soaked cashews, then blend with 1/2 cup water until smooth.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the cashew cream, salt, and white fish to the pan, then reduce heat to low and cook until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
Deglaze the pan with a little water if the curry becomes too thick.
